comment: files.c set_savefile_name() and restore_saved_game() on the judge's case-insensitive APFS volume: a normal-mode Samurai named Kasumi saves (save/<uid>Kasumi); the next segment names the hero KASUMI, whose save/<uid>KASUMI opens the same file, so C prints "Restoring save file..." and restores Kasumi (restore.c dorecover() reads the saved name). On Linux the second segment finds no file and starts a new game for KASUMI, so this recording must come from macOS (scripts/playground-case.test.mjs). Debug mode cannot show this: set_playmode() names every debug hero 'wizard'. Seed, date, Samurai and names chosen independently.
